procedure_name: Initial Registration Not Accepted by the Network

nodes.description: UE sends REGISTRATION REQUEST
AMF determines registration cannot be accepted (see Triggering Conditions)
AMF sends REGISTRATION REJECT message to the UE including an appropriate 5GMM cause value
UE receives REGISTRATION REJECT message
5GMM cause value in REGISTRATION REJECT = #3 or #6?
UE sets 5GS update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, deletes registration information, considers USIM/entry as invalid
5GMM cause value in REGISTRATION REJECT = #7?
UE sets 5GS update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, deletes registration information, considers USIM/entry as invalid
5GMM cause value in REGISTRATION REJECT = #10?
UE aborts the initial registration procedure
5GMM cause value in REGISTRATION REJECT = #11?
UE sets 5GS update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, deletes registration information, stores the PLMN identity in the forbidden PLMN list
5GMM cause value in REGISTRATION REJECT = #12?
UE sets 5GS update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, deletes TAI related information, enters 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE
5GMM cause value in REGISTRATION REJECT = #13?
UE sets 5GS update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, deletes TAI and registration information, enters 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE or 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH
5GMM cause value in REGISTRATION REJECT = #15?
UE sets 5GS update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, deletes TAI and registration information, stores current TAI, enters 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE
5GMM cause value in REGISTRATION REJECT = #22?
T3346 value IE is present and not zero/deactivated?
UE aborts initial registration, enters 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION, starts T3346
Abnormal case (UE specific action not defined in this procedure)
5GMM cause value in REGISTRATION REJECT = #27?
UE sets 5GS update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, deletes registration information, disables N1 mode capability, enters 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.LIMITED-SERVICE
5GMM cause value in REGISTRATION REJECT = #31?
UE enables E-UTRA capability, disables the N1 mode capability for 3GPP access, and enter the 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE
5GMM cause value in REGISTRATION REJECT = #36?
UE sets 5GS update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, deletes registration information, stores the PLMN identity in the forbidden PLMN list, enters state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH
5GMM cause value in REGISTRATION REJECT = #62?

UE aborts initial registration, enters 5GMM-DEREGISTERED. ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION or 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH, resets the registration attempt counter and takes actions based on the rejection cause in the rejected S-NSSAI(s).
5GMM cause value in REGISTRATION REJECT = #72?

UE sets the 5GS update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, deletes last visited registered TAI and TAI list. If the UE is not registering or has not registered to the same PLMN over 3GPP access, the UE shall additionally delete 5G-GUTI and ngKSI. Additionally, the UE shall reset the registration attempt counter and enter the state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.
5GMM cause value in REGISTRATION REJECT = #73?
UE sets 5GS update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, deletes registration information, stores the PLMN identity in the forbidden PLMN list, enters state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH
5GMM cause value in REGISTRATION REJECT = #74?

UE sets the 5GS update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, deletes registration information and the list of equivalent SNPNs (if available). The UE shall reset the registration attempt counter and store the SNPN identity in the temporarily forbidden SNPNs list.
5GMM cause value in REGISTRATION REJECT = #75?

UE sets the 5GS update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, deletes registration information and the list of equivalent SNPNs (if available). The UE shall reset the registration attempt counter and store the SNPN identity in the permanently forbidden SNPNs list.
5GMM cause value in REGISTRATION REJECT = #76?

The UE shall set the 5GS update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED and reset the registration attempt counter. If the 5GMM cause #76 is received from a CAG cell, and if the UE receives a CAG information list in the CAG information list IE or the Extended CAG information list IE included in the REGISTRATION REJECT message, the UE shall replace the CAG information list stored in the UE with the received CAG information list IE or the Extended CAG information list IE when received in the HPLMN or EHPLMN.
5GMM cause value in REGISTRATION REJECT = #77?
UE sets 5GS update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, deletes registration information, shall reset the registration attempt counter, shall enter the state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED
5GMM cause value in REGISTRATION REJECT = #78?

UE sets the 5GS update status to 5U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED, deletes last visited registered TAI and TAI list. If the UE is not registering or has not registered to the same PLMN over non-3GPP access, the UE shall additionally delete the list of equivalent PLMNs, 5G-GUTI and ngKSI.
5GMM cause value in REGISTRATION REJECT = #79?
UE aborts the initial registration procedure, sets the 5GS update status to 5U2 NOT UPDATED and enter state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED. ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION or 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH.
5GMM cause value in REGISTRATION REJECT = #80?

UE aborts the initial registration procedure, set the 5GS update status to 5U2 NOT UPDATED, enter state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED. PLMN-SEARCH and shall delete any 5G-GUTI, last visited registered TAI, TAI list and ngKSI.
5GMM cause value in REGISTRATION REJECT = #81?
UE aborts the initial registration procedure, set the 5GS update status to 5U2 NOT UPDATED and enter state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED. ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION or 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH.
5GMM cause value in REGISTRATION REJECT = #82?
UE aborts the initial registration procedure, set the 5GS update status to 5U2 NOT UPDATED and enter state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED. ATTEMPTING-REGISTRATION or 5GMM-DEREGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH.

edges.condition: T3346 value IE is present and not zero/deactivated
T3346 value IE is zero/deactivated or not present
